At least one challenger family lens.
At least one stakeholder family lens.
At least one temporal family lens.
Every lens should clash with at least one other lens in the set.
No two lenses that would say roughly the same thing.
Sets of 4 or more get one wildcard family lens.
A lens written for this specific problem beats any lens in the deck. Add custom lenses as 'Name: the question it asks'.
For judging or deciding, keep it to 3 or 4 distinct lenses; more lenses only pay off when generating ideas.
A lens changes the question and the required output, never the claimed expertise. Expert personas do not raise accuracy.

For a review, seat lenses whose findings would differ: a defect lens, a stakeholder who lives with the artifact, and a time lens. Never techniques, never a wildcard (the review presets set "wildcard": false).
